content: Docusaurus i18n: i18n/[locale]/[pluginName] directory per locale; site chrome (navbar, footer, React code strings) in JSON files using the Chrome i18n format (message+description per key); documents translated as whole files to preserve context; default locale declared in docusaurus.config.js; write-translations command bootstraps the JSON files. Reference pattern: chrome separated from content, JSON label catalogs, en as default.
